text:
maya.design: Quick thread — I mocked a "featherboard" onboarding UI: tiny unobtrusive card in the hero that expands into either an inline panel or a lightweight modal. Goal: low interruption but clear path to sample projects and quickstart. Need copy + a11y takes.

henry.product: Love the low-friction idea. Question: do we want the first-run to surface personalized samples or just a curated small set? Also metric ask: what does success look like (launch rate vs project creation)?

liam.eng: Personalization requires an extra backend call; can lazy-hydrate. We should show curated defaults immediately to avoid render jank. Persist dismiss state server-side for auth users; localStorage fallback for guests. Events: `featherboard.shown`, `featherboard.expanded`, `featherboard.sample_launched`, `featherboard.dismissed`.

tara.a11y: Accessibility checklist: 
- If modal option chosen, use `role=dialog` + `aria-modal=true` and move focus into it on open.
- Inline panel must have a meaningful heading and `aria-live=polite` for dynamic status updates.
- CTAs must be descriptive (avoid "Try" alone).
- Ensure focus order doesn't skip to content behind the panel; when closed, restore focus to the opener.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for expand animation.

maya.design: Copy candidates: 
Variant X: Headline "Run a starter project" / CTA "Launch Chat demo (2 min)" / helper "No setup needed"
Variant Y: Headline "See Redwood in action" / CTA "Open sample" / helper "Hands-on demo"
Which variant for homepage?

henry.product: Prefer Variant X for clarity and ETA. Also suggest showing a small badge if user already has projects: "You have 1 project — Open it" to avoid conflicting CTAs.

liam.eng: Implementation note: show badge via quick userProjectsCount call; if >0, collapse featherboard to small pill and surface 'Open project' as primary. Also avoid showing pulse animations for assistive tech users.

tara.a11y: Two nitpicks: 
1) Use full text labels for toggles: "Samples, collapsed" / "Samples, expanded" for SR clarity.
2) Ensure color contrast for helper chips in dark mode — some designs drop under 4.5:1.

maya.design: Action items: update prototype to Variant X copy, add project-aware badge, wire in aria attributes and reduced-motion. I'll also adjust CTA color for dark mode and post contrast screenshots.

henry.product: Rollout plan: 7-day experiment to 20% new orgs, track sample launch rate, project creation, and dismiss rate.

liam.eng: Dev estimate: 1.5 frontend days for UI + a11y behaviors, 0.5 backend day for persisted flag and event wiring. Will reuse existing dialog component for modal variant.

ship-bot: Staging deploy scheduled: 2024-09-10 11:00 PDT. Preview link will be posted after build.

maya.design: Thanks team — I'll push the updated mocks and acceptance criteria into the ticket. :sparkles:
